from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
p.write_text('[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"A connection configured for PROXY protocol routes the first bytes of the attacker-controlled request into the proxy parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1153,"var":"buffer","code":"switch on the first four bytes to choose PROXY v1 or v2 parsing","note":"The raw request buffer is interpreted as a PROXY header before normal HTTP parsing."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":223,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The parser treats attacker bytes as a fixed-layout PROXY v2 header and reads the declared length field from it."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (size > sizeof(*hdr)) return NULL;","note":"The code assumes the entire PROXY v2 frame must fit inside sizeof(*hdr), but the struct is only the minimum header size and not the full possible frame payload."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_from_request_socket","line":861,"var":"buffer->value[buffer->len]","code":"buffer->value[buffer->len] = '\0';","note":"The parser later null-terminates based on the computed length, so if the proxy length drives buffer state past the true request boundary, the write can target memory outside the intended request data."}
]
')
print(p.read_text())
